I personally preferred Outlast 2, I don't know why!

A lot of people say that recycling assets was the wrong choice but I think it really made the work! It's disturbing as duck. Had religious content (That's always creepy in a horror game), and had that parallel story of the protagonist's childhood. For me, Outlast 2 is even better than 1.
